reason: I have only ever hired builders through word of mouth, and I get three quotes before choosing. A platform fee on top of the builder's price has to give me something I cannot get myself, and nothing I have read so far shows that it does.
objection: That the platform's fee is extra money on top of what the builder charges, and I would still have to check each builder myself.
would_change_my_mind: Verified builders with reviews from past clients in my city, and a fee that comes out of a price lower than the best of my three quotes.
